name: 赎甲铺
Armour Redemption Shop
before: 沙地边一间铁匠铺，门口挂满了旧铠甲，甲片上都烙着「旱」字，是这些年从散了的营里流出来的。一伙海盗开着这铺子，把旧甲卖给过路的刀客。今天铺前排着一队白头发的老汉，捏着攒下的碎银，要把自己的甲赎回去，海盗一口咬定：「涨价了，十倍。」铺后还站着一队蜃兵替他们撑腰。

A smithy at the edge of the sands, its door hung with old armour, every plate branded 'Dry', all of it drifted out of the broken camp over the years. Pirates run the shop and sell the armour to passing swordsmen. Today a line of white-haired old men waits in front, clutching saved-up silver scraps to buy back their own armour, and the pirates insist: 'Price has gone up. Tenfold.' Behind the shop a squad of mirage soldiers backs them up.
after: 海盗被赶跑，老汉们一副副翻甲，每副甲的护心片背面都刻着名字，各人认各人的。他们说听人传，有一伙挂灯的船在找军主，旱海军的老兵就从四面八方往回走了。「军主没交令，我们就还是兵。」一个老汉把甲往身上一披，扣子扣不上了，肚子大了。

The pirates are run off and the old men turn the armour over piece by piece; each breastplate has a name scratched on the back, and each man finds his own. Word has spread, they say, that a ship hung with lanterns is looking for the Commander, so the Dry Sea veterans are walking back from every direction. 'The Commander never handed over his command, so we're still soldiers.' One old man throws his armour on and can't fasten it. His belly has grown.

name: 卫家老屋
The Wei Family House
before: 荒原上一座青砖老屋，门楣上挂着一块「军主第」的匾，匾已经裂了。屋里住着军主的妻子卫嫂，靠给人缝补衣甲过日子。一伙税丁带着几个蜃兵堵在门口，拿着一张欠单：旱海军散营时欠了县里三百石粮，「军主不在，就拿军主的屋抵」。卫嫂把一根顶门杠横在胸前。

An old blue-brick house on the plain, a cracked plaque over the door reading 'Residence of the Commander'. Inside lives the Commander's wife, Mistress Wei, who gets by mending clothes and armour. A troop of tax runners with a few mirage soldiers is blocking the door, waving a bill: when the Dry Sea Army broke up it owed the county three hundred piculs of grain. 'The Commander isn't here, so the Commander's house will cover it.' Mistress Wei holds a door bar across her chest.
after: 税丁被赶走了，欠单撕了。卫嫂从箱底取出一封信，是丈夫上岛前留的：「令在我手，代者未至。岛上有千里号留给本军的一样东西，取回来，补上兄弟们的饷，便回。」信纸边上画着一座冒烟的岛。她说他这人说话从不算错日子，这一回算错了十年。

The tax runners are driven off and the bill is torn up. From the bottom of a chest Mistress Wei takes a letter her husband left before he went to the island: 'The command is still in my hands; no relief has come. On the island is something the Qianli left for this army. I'll fetch it, make up the brothers' pay, and come home.' In the margin is a sketch of a smoking island. She says he never once got a date wrong in his life. This time he's ten years out.

name: 埋罐坡
Buried Jar Slope
before: 沙坡上一伙走私盐的挖了一个大坑，坑底露出一只封着蜡的大陶罐。他们听说旱海军当年在这一带埋过饷银，罐子一露头，就为分银子打了起来，又拉来一队蜃骑助阵。挖坑的雇工是个老盐丁，被他们推在坑边，抱着脑袋：「那不是银子！我看见他们埋的！」

On a sandy slope a gang of salt smugglers has dug a big pit, and at its bottom sits a large pottery jar sealed with wax. They've heard the Dry Sea Army buried pay silver around here years ago, and the moment the jar showed they started fighting over shares, calling up a troop of mirage riders to help. Their hired digger, an old salt guard, has been shoved to the pit's edge with his arms over his head. 'It's not silver! I saw them bury it!'
after: 走私的被赶跑了。罐子里没有银子，只有一卷油布，布上是沈渡的字：「谢旱海军三日护送。本号不能替朝廷发饷，只能还账：东北岛上，石柱之间，存粮一年，银三千两，抵贵军一月之饷。沈渡。」老盐丁记得，军主读完信，第二天就去海边找船了。

The smugglers are chased off. There's no silver in the jar, only a roll of oilcloth in Shen Du's hand: 'With thanks to the Dry Sea Army for three days' escort. This company cannot pay soldiers on the court's behalf; it can only settle its debts. On the island to the north-east, among the stone pillars: a year's grain and three thousand taels of silver, to cover your army's month of pay. Shen Du.' The old salt guard remembers the Commander reading the letter and going down to the coast to find a boat the very next day.

name: 裁撤令
The Disbandment Order
before: 大路上来了一支官差，打着兵部的旗，领头的是个白胖的书吏，身后跟着一队刀客和蜃骑。他是来追旱海军的旧账的：营里当年领了三百副弓、六十口锅，散营时没有交还，「人散了，账不能散」。他一路走一路抓人，见了穿旧甲的就往车上捆。

Officials come down the high road under the banner of the Ministry of War, led by a pale, plump clerk with swordsmen and mirage riders behind him. He's here to chase the Dry Sea Army's old accounts: the camp drew three hundred bows and sixty cooking pots and never returned them when it broke up. 'The men may scatter, but the books may not.' He arrests as he goes, tying anyone in old armour onto his cart.
after: 刀客被打跑，车上的老兵都放了。书吏抖着手拿出一张公文，说是他的本钱：「丁未年九月，旱海军裁撤，军主卫长庚即日交令回京。」公文盖着大印，却从没送到过：送公文的驿卒半路逃了。老兵们看着看着，笑出了眼泪：「裁了十年，我们还在这儿守着。」

The swordsmen are run off and the old soldiers on the cart are freed. With shaking hands the clerk brings out a document he calls his authority: 'Ninth month, Dingwei year: the Dry Sea Army is disbanded; Commander Wei Changgeng is to hand over his command and return to the capital forthwith.' It bears the great seal, and it was never delivered: the courier deserted halfway. The old soldiers read it and laugh until they cry. 'Disbanded ten years, and here we still are, standing guard.'

name: 烟岛渡
Smoke Island Ferry
before: 海边一座小渡口，正对着东北海上那座岛，岛顶一缕白烟，日夜不散。渡口的船全被一伙海盗扣着，说岛上有千里号的宝贝，要自己去取，可他们去了三回，三回都被烟呛回来。撑渡的渡娘不肯带路，海盗就把她的船底凿了个洞，拴在码头上泡着。

A little ferry landing facing the island in the north-east sea, a wisp of white smoke on its summit day and night. A pirate band has impounded every boat here, saying the island holds Qianli treasure they mean to fetch themselves, but they've tried three times and three times been choked back by the smoke. The ferrywoman won't guide them, so they knocked a hole in her boat's bottom and left it tied at the quay to soak.
after: 海盗被赶跑，龚墨斗把渡船的洞补上了。渡娘说岛上那缕烟是地火，烧了几百年，不吃人，只是呛：「顺着风走，别往烟里钻。」十年前她渡过一条小船去岛上，十一个人，领头的披着甲，「他说回来时给我付船钱。船钱我还记着账」。

The pirates are chased off and Gong Modou patches the ferry's hull. The ferrywoman says the smoke on the island is earth-fire that's been burning for centuries; it doesn't kill, it just chokes. 'Keep upwind and don't go poking into the smoke.' Ten years ago she ferried a small boat out there, eleven men, their leader in armour. 'He said he'd pay the fare on the way back. I've still got it on the books.'

name: 蜃虫窝
Mirage Grub Nest
before: 盐滩深处有一片软泥，泥里钻着成千上万的蜃虫，白白胖胖，指头粗，一张嘴吐一口热气，热气上就浮出一小片假景：一棵树、一口锅、一个招手的人。过路的人朝假景走，一脚陷进泥里，蜃虫就围上来啃。这几天虫群爬出泥窝，往盐工的晒场去了。

Deep in the salt flat lies a stretch of soft mud alive with tens of thousands of mirage grubs, fat and white and finger-thick, and each time one opens its mouth it breathes out a puff of heat with a little false scene floating on it: a tree, a pot, a beckoning figure. Travellers walk toward the scenes, sink into the mud, and the grubs swarm in to nibble. These past days the swarm has been crawling out of its nest toward the salt workers' drying yards.
after: 这一回的虫群被赶回了泥窝，晒场边的假景一个个灭了。盐工们说蜃虫是大蜃的子孙，泥底下一窝接一窝地孵，一个夏天能孵三回，怎么也清不干净。只能隔一阵来赶一回，别让它们爬上晒场。走的时候，泥面上又浮起了一小片假景：一个招手的人。

This time the swarm is driven back into its mud, and the false scenes by the drying yards wink out one by one. The salt workers say mirage grubs are the great shen's offspring, hatching brood after brood under the mud, three times a summer, impossible to clear for good. All you can do is come back every so often to drive them off before they reach the yards. As you leave, another little false scene floats up off the mud: a beckoning figure.

name: 老兵集
Veterans' Muster
before: 盐滩上一座歪歪斜斜的酒棚，棚前棚后坐满了白头发的老汉，有的拄拐，有的背着锈刀，都是旱海军的老兵，听说有人要去岛上找军主，一路赶来。一伙海盗嫌这群老头占了路口，带着蜃兵来撵，老兵们站起来，排成了一列，腿脚哆嗦，队形倒还是齐的。

A lopsided wine shed on the salt flat, its front and back crowded with white-haired old men, some on crutches, some carrying rusty swords: Dry Sea veterans who've come on the news that someone's going to the island to find the Commander. A pirate band, annoyed that the old men are blocking the crossroads, comes with mirage soldiers to clear them, and the veterans stand and form a single rank, legs trembling, line still dead straight.
after: 海盗被打跑，老兵们坐回棚里，一个一个报名，报了三百多个。老鼓拿着兵册一个个对：「张二，在。」「李满仓，在。」念到死了的，大家一齐说「在」。他合上兵册：「人是齐了，可没有令，兵不成军。」

The pirates are run off and the veterans sit back down and give their names one by one, more than three hundred of them. Old Drum checks each against the roll. 'Zhang Er.' 'Here.' 'Li Mancang.' 'Here.' When he reads the name of a man who's dead, they all answer 'Here' together. He closes the roll. 'The men are all here. But without the command token, soldiers aren't an army.'

name: 幻军阵
Phantom Host
before: 老兵们往海边走，荒原上忽然起了一片军阵，旗是「旱」字旗，兵是十年前的年轻脸，蜃骑在前，蜃兵在后，挡住了去路。这是天上那片军阵落到了地上，它不认得这些老了的人，只当是外人。阵后还藏着一伙海盗，趁乱抢老兵的干粮。

As the veterans head for the coast a whole army suddenly rises on the plain, banners marked 'Dry', soldiers with the young faces of ten years ago, mirage riders in front and mirage infantry behind, blocking the way. It's the formation from the sky come down to earth, and it doesn't know these old men; it takes them for strangers. A pirate band lurks behind it too, snatching the veterans' rations in the confusion.
after: 幻阵散了，海盗也跑了。老兵们站在原地，半天没说话：方才对面那个年轻的旗手，就是老旗手自己十年前的样子。老旗手拍了拍自己的胸口：「它记得我们年轻的时候，不记得我们老了。」他转身对你们说：「令在岛上，我们等你们取回来。」

The phantom host dissolves and the pirates flee. The veterans stand where they are, silent a long while: the young flag-bearer across the field just now was the old flag-bearer himself, ten years ago. He thumps his own chest. 'It remembers us young. It doesn't remember us old.' He turns to you. 'The token is on the island. We'll wait for you to bring it back.'

name: 浮石湾
Pumice Cove
before: 海边一道小湾，湾里漂着一层灰白的石头，大的像枕头，小的像馒头，随着浪一起一伏，石头竟然不沉。一伙海盗在湾里捞石头，说是「龙宫的玉」，一筐筐运去卖。捡石头的小孩被他们撵到礁上，手里还攥着一块，石头上刻着歪歪扭扭的一个字。

A little cove where the water is covered with grey-white stones, some big as pillows, some small as buns, bobbing on the waves without sinking. A pirate band is fishing them out, calling them 'jade from the Dragon Palace' and hauling them off by the basket to sell. The children who used to collect them have been chased onto the rocks, and one still clutches a stone with a crooked character scratched into it.
after: 海盗被赶跑了。渡娘拿起一块石头掂了掂：「这是浮石，岛上地火喷出来的石浆，一冷，里头全是气泡，比水还轻，能在海上漂好几个月。」孩子手里那块刻着「在」。礁缝里还塞着几十块，块块刻着「在」，最新的一块刻的是「九」。岛上的人一直在往这边报数。

The pirates are chased off. The ferrywoman picks up a stone and weighs it in her hand. 'This is pumice. Molten rock the earth-fire throws out on the island; it cools full of bubbles, lighter than water, and can float at sea for months.' The child's stone is scratched 'Here'. Wedged in the cracks of the cove's rocks are dozens more, every one scratched 'Here', and the newest reads 'Nine'. For ten years the people on the island have been sending their count across.

name: 开饭沙
Mealtime Sands
before: 瓢叔把那口千人锅拉到了靴冢边上，要给回来的老兵们熬一锅粥，老鼓擂鼓，老旗手升旗。可起风了，风卷着盐沙往锅里灌，沙里又冒出一队蜃兵，围着锅转，还有几个饿疯了的海盗趁着风沙扑上来抢锅里的米。

Uncle Ladle has hauled his pot for a thousand to the Boot Mound to boil congee for the returning veterans, Old Drum beating the drum, the old flag-bearer raising the banner. But a wind has got up, driving salt grit into the pot, and out of the grit rises a squad of mirage soldiers circling the pot, while a few half-starved pirates rush in under cover of the dust to grab the rice.
after: 蜃兵散了，海盗被捆着蹲在锅边，瓢叔还是给他们也盛了一碗。粥熬好，瓢叔敲了三下锅沿：「开饭。」这一回来了四百多人。老兵们捧着碗，没人先动筷子，都朝东北海上那座岛望着：「等军主回来，一起吃。」

The mirage soldiers scatter and the pirates squat trussed beside the pot, and Uncle Ladle still ladles them a bowl each. When the congee's done he strikes the rim three times. 'Food's up.' This time more than four hundred come. The veterans hold their bowls and no one starts; they all look toward the island in the north-east sea. 'We'll eat together when the Commander's back.'

name: 点卯道
Roll-Call Road
before: 去海边的大道上，兵部那个白胖书吏又回来了，这回带了更多的刀客和一队蜃骑，路上贴着告示：「旱海军已裁，聚众者以谋逆论。」他听说几百个老兵聚在一起，吓得连夜搬了救兵，要在大路上把他们一个个点名拿下。

On the high road to the coast the pale, plump Ministry clerk is back, this time with more swordsmen and a troop of mirage riders, and notices are posted along the way: 'The Dry Sea Army is disbanded. Any who assemble will be charged with rebellion.' Hearing several hundred veterans have gathered, he panicked and fetched reinforcements overnight, meaning to call their names on the road and arrest them one by one.
after: 刀客被打散，书吏缩在车底下不肯出来。老鼓把他拉出来，递给他那本兵册：「点吧。」书吏抖着嗓子点了一遍名，老兵们一个个答「在」。点完，他半天才说：「这本册子，比兵部的还齐。」他把告示揭了，自己也没走，蹲在路边等着看那只令。

The swordsmen are scattered and the clerk hides under his cart and won't come out. Old Drum hauls him out and hands him the muster roll. 'Go on, call it.' In a shaking voice the clerk calls the roll, and one by one the veterans answer 'Here'. When he's done it's a while before he speaks. 'This roll is more complete than the Ministry's.' He takes down his notices, and doesn't leave either: he squats by the road, waiting to see the token.

name: 石柱营
Pillar Camp
before: 烟岛的北坡全是黑石柱，一根挨一根，截面六角，齐整得像有人砌过，柱间搭着十一座窝棚。一伙海盗刚撬开柱缝里藏的粮窖，正往外扛米，窝棚里冲出十个白发老兵，拿着鱼叉拦他们。天刚蒙蒙亮，最高那根石柱顶上浮出一个人影：披甲，年轻，按着刀，正是天上那条小船船头站着的人。

The north slope of Smoke Island is all black stone pillars, close-packed, six-sided in section, so regular they might have been laid by masons, with eleven huts built between them. A pirate band has just pried open a grain cache hidden in the cracks between the pillars and is hauling rice out, and ten white-haired old soldiers rush from the huts with fish spears to stop them. Day is just breaking, and on top of the tallest pillar a figure floats up: armoured, young, hand on his sword, the very man who stood in the bow of the little boat in the sky.
after: 海盗被打下了海。十个老兵说，军主去年冬天走了，临走让他们把令埋进他每天早上站的那根石柱缝里：「代者来了，就在这儿交。」龚墨斗摸着石柱说，这是岩浆冷下来往里缩，裂成的六角柱子。这时柱顶的人影朝你们抬手，指向脚下一道裂缝。你们伸手进去，摸到一块冰凉的铜牌：军主令，正面「旱海」，背面「代者持此」。人影把手按在胸口，朝你们一揖，日头一出，化成了一缕烟。十个老兵跪了下来。千里号留的银子，他们一两没动。

The pirates are driven into the sea. The ten old soldiers say the Commander died last winter, and before he went he had them bury the token in the crack of the pillar where he stood each morning. 'When relief comes, hand it over here.' Gong Modou runs a hand over the stone: molten rock cooling and shrinking inward, he says, splits into six-sided columns like these. Then the figure on the pillar lifts a hand toward you and points to a crack at its feet. You reach in and touch a cold bronze tablet: the Commander's Token, 'Dry Sea' on its face and on the back, 'Borne by the one who relieves me.' The figure presses a hand to its chest and bows to you, and as the sun comes up it turns to a wisp of smoke. The ten old soldiers kneel. Of the silver the Qianli left, they never touched a tael.

name: 送船坞
Send-Off Slip
before: 海边一座塌了半边的船坞，坞里搁着一条造了一半的小船，龙骨上的刨花都发黑了。坞主是个老船匠，十年前给军主造过那条上岛的小船。一伙海盗占了船坞，要把半成品拆了当柴，老船匠拿着墨斗线，绕着船走，谁靠近就弹谁一脸墨。

A half-collapsed boat shed by the sea holds a small boat half built, the shavings on its keel gone black. The owner is an old shipwright who built the Commander's boat for the island ten years ago. A pirate band has taken the shed and wants to break up the unfinished hull for firewood, and the old man circles the boat with a chalk line, snapping ink into the face of anyone who comes near.
after: 海盗被赶跑，龚墨斗跟老船匠一见如故。老船匠说这条半成品是给军主回程造的：「他说取了东西就回，回来要条大点的船，装得下十一个人和三千两银子。」船造到一半，人没回来，他就停了手。龚墨斗卷起袖子：「剩下一半，我帮你造完。」

The pirates are chased off and Gong Modou and the old shipwright hit it off at once. The old man says the half-built boat was for the Commander's return. 'He said he'd fetch it and come back, and when he did he'd need a bigger boat, to hold eleven men and three thousand taels.' Halfway through, no one came back, so he stopped. Gong Modou rolls up his sleeves. 'The other half, I'll help you finish.'

name: 穿靴原
Boot-Donning Plain
before: 老兵们都聚到了靴冢前，四百多人，各自蹲在自己那双靴子跟前，就是不肯穿：要等令。一伙盐枭听说老兵们手里有千里号的银子，带着一队蜃兵蜃弓手围了上来，喊着要「借」几袋。老兵们抓起靴子当武器，一时间满天都是飞靴。

The veterans have all gathered at the Boot Mound, more than four hundred, each crouched before his own pair of boots and refusing to put them on: they're waiting for the token. A gang of salt smugglers has heard the veterans hold Qianli silver and closes in with mirage soldiers and archers, shouting that they'd like to 'borrow' a few bags. The veterans snatch up their boots as weapons, and the air fills with flying footwear.
after: 盐枭被打跑了。你们举起军主令，老鼓擂了三通鼓，四百多人齐刷刷穿上靴子，抖出十年的沙。老旗手接过令看了一遍，又还给你们：「军主说过，千里号进蜃，最后要过那只大蜃。它记着路，也守着路。」他朝东一指：「拿这块令去兵营喊一声，我们就来。」

The smugglers are run off. You raise the Commander's Token, Old Drum beats three rolls, and four hundred men pull on their boots as one, shaking out ten years of sand. The old flag-bearer takes the token, looks it over, and hands it back. 'The Commander said that to go through the Mirage, the Qianli would have to get past the great shen last of all. It remembers the road, and it guards it too.' He points east. 'Take this token to a barracks and give a shout. We'll come.'

name: 分银坪
Silver-Sharing Ground
before: 老兵们从岛上运回了千里号留的三千两银子，在一块平地上按兵册分饷，一人一份。可一伙海盗早盯上了这批银子，带着最后的蜃骑冲了过来，还有几个兵部的刀客混在其中，说银子该「缴库」。白胖书吏站在中间，左右为难。

The veterans have brought the Qianli's three thousand taels back from the island and are sharing out pay by the muster roll on a patch of level ground, one share each. But a pirate band has had its eye on the silver all along and charges in with the last of its mirage riders, a few of the Ministry's swordsmen mixed in among them, saying the silver belongs 'in the treasury'. The pale, plump clerk stands in the middle, torn both ways.
after: 海盗和刀客被打散。书吏想了想，在自己的公文背面写了一行：「旱海军丁未年八月饷，千里号代付，已讫。」盖上了兵部的印。老兵们领了饷，每人先拿出一钱，凑给渡娘付了十年前的船钱。瓢叔说：「军主的账，总算平了。」

The pirates and swordsmen are scattered. The clerk thinks for a while, then writes a line on the back of his own document: 'Dry Sea Army pay, eighth month of the Dingwei year, paid on its behalf by the Qianli. Settled.' And he stamps it with the Ministry's seal. When the veterans have their pay, each first puts in a mace of silver, and together they pay the ferrywoman her fare from ten years ago. 'The Commander's accounts are square at last,' says Uncle Ladle.

name: 送行沙
Farewell Sands
before: 老兵们一路把你们送到盐滩东头，再往东，天上的蜃楼就压得很低了，低得像要落到地上。一伙从东边逃过来的海盗慌慌张张撞上了送行的队伍，后头追着一大群蜃兵，蜃兵见人就砍，连海盗也砍：它们已经分不出谁是谁了。

The veterans escort you all the way to the eastern end of the salt flat; beyond it, the Mirage hangs low in the sky, so low it looks about to touch the ground. A band of pirates fleeing from the east blunders into the escort, a horde of mirage soldiers hard on their heels, cutting down anyone they meet, pirates included: they can no longer tell who's who.
after: 蜃兵散了，逃来的海盗跪在地上直磕头，说东边山脚下的蜃兵越来越疯，连蜃楼市舶司的人都不敢出门了。老鼓擂了最后一通鼓，老兵们在沙上站成两行：「军主没走完的，你们替他走完。」你们回头望，四百多人一直站着，直到看不见了。

The mirage soldiers scatter, and the fleeing pirates kneel and knock their heads on the ground, saying the mirage soldiers at the foot of the eastern mountains grow wilder by the day; even the people of the Mirage Customs House don't dare go out. Old Drum beats one last roll and the veterans form two lines on the sand. 'What the Commander didn't finish, you finish for him.' Looking back, you see four hundred men still standing there until they're out of sight.

name: 喘气原
Breathing Plain
before: 荒原上的地，一个时辰起伏一回，像有什么在底下慢慢吸气、呼气；地一鼓，草根底下就渗出咸水。一伙海盗和一大队蜃兵在这片原上扎营，营帐一会儿高一会儿低，海盗们晕得直吐，却舍不得走：他们说地一喘，天上的楼就亮一回，楼亮的时候，地缝里会冒出珠子。

The ground on this plain rises and falls once an hour, as though something beneath were slowly breathing in and out; each time it swells, salt water seeps up between the grass roots. A pirate band and a big troop of mirage soldiers have camped here, their tents rising and sinking, and the pirates are seasick but won't leave: each time the ground breathes, they say, the towers in the sky brighten, and when they do, pearls come up through the cracks.
after: 海盗被打散了。小桨趴在地上听了一个时辰：「一呼一吸，比上一回慢了。」一个背筐的蛤户老汉路过，叫他别趴了：「你们脚底下踩的是它的壳边。它老了，喘得一年比一年慢。」老汉从地缝里抠出一粒米大的珠子，白里透灰：「掉珠子，是它在掉记性。」

The pirates are scattered. Xiaojiang lies listening with his ear to the ground for an hour. 'In, out. Slower than last time.' An old clam-digger with a basket on his back passes and tells him to get up. 'You're standing on the rim of its shell. It's old; it breathes slower every year.' He picks a pearl the size of a rice grain out of a crack, white going grey. 'When it drops pearls, it's dropping memories.'

name: 摸壳屯
Shell-Touch Hamlet
before: 一片矮屋，屋顶压着大贝壳，是蛤户住的屯子。一伙采珠海盗占了屯子，逼蛤户带路去找「蜃珠」，蛤户不肯，海盗就砸贝壳。屯里有个十来岁的男孩，光着脚在地上走来走去，走几步就趴下摸一摸地，海盗以为他在找珠子，揪着他的领子问个不停。

A cluster of low houses roofed with big shells: a hamlet of clam-diggers. Pearl-poaching pirates have taken it and are pressing the diggers to lead them to the 'shen pearl', smashing shells when they refuse. A boy of ten or so walks barefoot back and forth, and every few steps he lies down to feel the ground; the pirates think he's hunting pearls and hold him by the collar, questioning him without pause.
after: 海盗被赶走了。男孩叫珠儿，蚌婆的孙子。他摸地是在「问路」：哪块凉，哪块温，哪块底下有水在走，他都摸得出来。「温的地方是它的心口，奶奶说千万别在那儿打桩。」他领你们去看海盗打的铁桩，桩子正钉在一块温热的地上。

The pirates are run off. The boy is Zhu'er, grandson of Granny Clam. Feeling the ground is how he 'asks the way': which patch is cool, which warm, where water runs underneath, he can tell them all. 'The warm place is its heart. Granny says never drive a stake there.' He takes you to see the iron stakes the pirates drove, and they're hammered into a patch of warm ground.

name: 哼歌屋
Humming House
before: 沙地中间一座贝壳垒的小屋，屋前一个白发老太太，每晚坐在地上唱歌，唱完了把耳朵贴在地上听。她就是蚌婆，守了这只大蜃五十年。一伙采珠海盗扛着铁钎围住她，要她说出蜃珠在哪儿，蚌婆闭着眼照旧唱，一个音也没走。

A little house built of shells in the middle of the sands, and before it a white-haired old woman who sits on the ground singing every night, then lays her ear to the earth to listen. This is Granny Clam, keeper of the great shen for fifty years. Pearl-poaching pirates with iron bars have surrounded her, demanding she tell them where the shen pearl is, and Granny Clam goes on singing with her eyes closed, not a note out of tune.
after: 海盗散了。蚌婆说她唱，它就哼，五十年都是一个调子；十年前它忽然学会了一支新歌，「是那年过路的船上一个汉子唱给它听的，哄孩子睡觉的调子」。阿汐跪下来，把耳朵贴在地上：地底下一个很慢、很低的声音，哼的正是她爹那支歌。

The pirates scatter. When she sings, Granny Clam says, it hums back, and for fifty years it was always the same tune. Then ten years ago it suddenly learned a new song. 'A man on a passing ship sang it to it that year. A tune for putting a child to sleep.' Axi kneels and lays her ear to the ground: from far below comes a very slow, very low sound, humming her father's song.

name: 剖珠坊
Pearl-Cutting Workshop
before: 荒原上一间小作坊，坊主是个眯眼的老珠匠，叫老砗，专收大蜃掉下来的碎珠，一粒粒剖开看。一伙采珠海盗冲进坊里，要他把攒的珠子全交出来，说剖开了就不值钱了，留着卖。老砗把一盒半开的珠子护在怀里：「剖开才值钱！这里头是日子！」

A little workshop on the plain run by a squinting old pearl-cutter called Old Che, who collects the broken pearls the great shen sheds and splits them open one by one to look inside. Pearl-poaching pirates burst in demanding every pearl he's saved, since split pearls are worthless and whole ones sell. Old Che hugs a box of half-opened pearls to his chest. 'Split, they're worth more! There are days in here!'
after: 海盗被打跑。老砗把剖开的珠子摆给你们看：一层裹一层，像树的年轮。老的那几层厚，一圈一圈清清楚楚；最外头这几年的，薄得像纸，还断了好几处。「它在忘。」他挑出一粒，十年前那一层里裹着一星红漆：「船底的漆。那年有船从它身上过。」

The pirates are chased off. Old Che lays the split pearls out for you: layer wrapped around layer, like a tree's rings. The old layers are thick, ring after ring perfectly clear; the last few years' are paper thin and broken in several places. 'It's forgetting.' He picks one out: wrapped in the layer from ten years ago is a fleck of red paint. 'Hull paint. That year ships passed over it.'

name: 钻壳场
Shell-Drilling Ground
before: 沙地上竖着一排木架，架上吊着铁钻，一伙采珠海盗轮班摇着绞盘，往地底下钻。钻杆一拔出来，钻眼里就往外冒咸水，冒一阵，地就疼似的抖一下。几个蜃兵守在木架旁，可地每抖一回，蜃兵就淡一层，海盗们骂骂咧咧，照钻不误。

A row of timber frames stands on the sand with iron drills hanging from them, and pearl-poaching pirates take turns cranking the winches to bore into the ground. Each time a drill rod comes out, salt water wells up from the hole, and after a while the ground shudders as if in pain. A few mirage soldiers guard the frames, but each shudder makes them fainter, and the pirates curse and keep drilling.
after: 海盗被赶跑，木架推倒了。珠儿趴在钻眼边，拿泥一个个堵上，堵一个，地就松一口气。钻头上錾着一个「钩」字。海盗的工簿上写着：「钩七令：再钻三丈，见珠。见珠者赏米十石。」赏的不是银子，是米。

The pirates are chased off and the frames toppled. Zhu'er lies beside the bore holes and plugs them with mud one by one, and with each the ground seems to let out a breath. The drill bits are stamped with the character 'Hook'. The pirates' work book reads: 'Hook Seven's orders: three more zhang and you'll reach the pearl. Ten piculs of rice to whoever reaches it.' The reward isn't silver. It's rice.

name: 晒贝场
Shell-Drying Yard
before: 沙地上一大片晒场，蛤户们把挖来的沙蛤、蛏子摊在草席上晒干，一年的口粮全靠它。一伙贝贩霸了晒场，压价收贝，一筐贝只给一碗米，不卖就不许晒，还雇了一队蜃弓手守着场子。蛤户们只好把湿贝堆在家门口，一堆堆臭了。

A great drying yard on the sand where the clam-diggers spread the clams and razor shells they dig on straw mats to dry, a year's food for them. A gang of shell dealers has seized the yard and forces prices down to a bowl of rice per basket, letting no one dry who won't sell, with a squad of mirage archers to guard it. The diggers have had to leave their wet catch heaped at their doors, where it's going bad.
after: 贝贩被撵走了，草席重新铺满了晒场，咸腥味里透着太阳味。蚌婆说，蛤户挖的是大蜃壳边上的小蛤，「它身上长的，它不心疼；它心疼的是有人往它心口钻」。晒场边立着一根木桩，桩上挂着一串贝壳，是蛤户记日子的，一天一枚。

The shell dealers are thrown out and the mats are spread across the yard again, the briny smell shot through with the smell of sunshine. Granny Clam says the diggers only take the little clams along the great shen's shell rim. 'Things that grow on it, it doesn't mind. What it minds is someone boring into its heart.' At the yard's edge stands a post hung with a string of shells: the diggers' calendar, one shell a day.
first: 晒场的库房里抄出贝贩囤的八十袋干蛤、三十串干蛏、两缸米，还有一杆做了手脚的秤，秤砣里灌了铅。

From the yard's storehouse you seize the dealers' hoard: eighty sacks of dried clams, thirty strings of dried razor shells, two vats of rice, and a rigged steelyard whose weight has been filled with lead.
pass: 每次路过，蛤户们都给你们装一袋晒得正好的干蛤，珠儿趴在车轮边摸一摸地，说：「今天它喘得匀，你们走得顺。」
Each time you pass, the clam-diggers fill a sack with perfectly dried clams for you, and Zhu'er lies down by the cart wheels to feel the ground. 'It's breathing evenly today. You'll travel well.'

name: 报信祭
Telling Festival
before: 蛤户每年秋天办一回「报信祭」：全屯的人围坐在地上，一个个对着地说这一年的事，谁家娶亲，谁家添丁，哪片滩来了新鱼。说完，晚上天上的楼里就会映出这一年的样子。今年祭场被采珠海盗占了，他们不许人聚，说蜃记性越差越好，好下钻。

Every autumn the clam-diggers hold a Telling Festival: the whole hamlet sits on the ground and each person tells the earth the year's news, whose son married, whose wife had a baby, which shoal brought new fish. That night the towers in the sky show the year as it was. This year the festival ground has been taken by the pearl poachers, who forbid any gathering: the worse the shen's memory, they say, the easier it is to drill.
after: 海盗被赶跑，蛤户们坐了一地，你们也跟着说了几句一路上的事。夜里天上果然映出了楼，可映得乱七八糟：去年的新娘牵着前年的新郎，张家的娃坐在李家的屋顶上。蚌婆看着看着笑了，又叹了口气：「它都收着呢，就是放乱了。」

The pirates are chased off and the diggers sit down all over the ground; you join in and tell a little of your journey. That night towers do appear in the sky, but all in a jumble: last year's bride leading the year before's groom, the Zhangs' baby sitting on the Lis' roof. Granny Clam laughs as she watches, then sighs. 'It's kept it all. It's just put it back in the wrong places.'

name: 观蜃台
Mirage-Watching Platform
before: 荒原高处一座木台，台上架着铜尺、竹竿、刻着格子的木板，是一个老学究的观蜃台：他从京城来，记了二十年蜃楼，哪天出、出几刻、出什么，都记在册子上。一伙海盗嫌他的竹竿碍事，又疑心册子里记着藏宝的地方，正把台子往下拆。

A timber platform on high ground, set with bronze rules, bamboo poles and boards scored into grids: an old scholar's mirage observatory. He came from the capital and has recorded the Mirage for twenty years, which days it appears, for how long, showing what, all written in his volumes. A pirate band finds his poles in the way, suspects his volumes record hidden treasure, and is pulling the platform down.
after: 海盗被打跑，老学究抱着册子爬回台上。他翻给你们看：十年前八月廿八以后，每天清早，天上头一样东西总是一条灯路，一串灯从西往东，铺在海面上空，像在给谁指路。「十年，一天没断过。」可近两年的册子里，灯路断成了一截一截，最近一页只画了七盏。

The pirates are run off and the old scholar climbs back onto the platform hugging his volumes. He shows you: after the twenty-eighth of the eighth month ten years ago, every morning the first thing in the sky was always a road of lights, a string of lamps running west to east above the sea, as if showing someone the way. 'Ten years, not one day missed.' But in the last two years' volumes the road is broken into pieces, and the latest page shows only seven lamps.

name: 瞭珠哨
Pearl Lookout
before: 沙地尽头一座土哨，哨顶插着一面画着钩子的旗，是钩七的瞭望哨，专看哪里的地在喘、哪里冒珠子，看见了就放烟报信。哨里的采珠海盗不多，可都是钩七的老手，夜里不点灯，白天裹着沙色的布趴在哨顶，跟沙地一个颜色。

At the end of the sands stands an earthen lookout flying a banner painted with a hook: Hook Seven's watch post, set to spot where the ground breathes and where pearls surface, and signal with smoke when they do. There aren't many pearl poachers inside, but they're all Hook Seven's old hands, showing no light at night and lying on the roof by day wrapped in sand-coloured cloth, the same colour as the desert.
after: 哨兵被打下了哨顶。哨簿最后几页记着钩七的打算：钻不下去，就去南边山脚，从大蜃壳和山石接缝的地方埋火药，「一炸，珠子自己就出来了」。簿子背面还有一行歪字：「岛上又饿死两个。快。」

The lookouts are knocked off the roof. The last pages of the post's log set out Hook Seven's plan: if the drills won't go through, go to the mountain foot in the south and pack gunpowder where the great shen's shell meets the rock. 'One blast and the pearl will come out by itself.' On the back is a crooked line: 'Two more starved on the island. Hurry.'

name: 借梦店
Borrowed-Dream Inn
before: 荒原路边一间客店，门口挂着「借梦」的幌子：在这儿睡一觉，就会梦见一段路，路上有船有灯，醒来记得清清楚楚。一伙海盗占了客店，把梦论夜卖，一夜一两银子，还拿蜃兵守着门。小桨一听就要进去睡，被海盗一脚踹了出来。

A roadside inn on the plain with a banner reading 'Dreams to Borrow': sleep a night here and you'll dream a stretch of road, ships and lamps on it, and remember every bit when you wake. A pirate band has taken over the inn and sells the dreams by the night, a tael of silver each, with mirage soldiers guarding the door. Xiaojiang wants to go straight in and sleep, and gets kicked straight back out.
after: 海盗被撵走，小桨倒头就睡。半夜他梦见一条船，雾里，船头趴着一个干瘦的老头，侧着耳朵听水，嘴里念叨：「快到了，前头那片冷水底下有东西，大得没有边，它在记路，别吵它。」小桨醒来，满脸是泪：「是爷爷。」店主说，这店底下就是大蜃的壳，梦是它漏出来的。

The pirates are thrown out and Xiaojiang falls asleep the moment he lies down. In the middle of the night he dreams of a ship in fog with a wiry old man lying across its bow, ear turned to the water, listening and saying as he listens: 'Nearly there. Under that cold water ahead is something with no edges. It's memorising the road. Don't disturb it.' Xiaojiang wakes with his face wet. 'That was Grandad.' The innkeeper says the inn stands right on the great shen's shell, and the dreams are what leaks out of it.

name: 瘦岛棚
Lean Island Shacks
before: 沙地上搭着一片破棚子，住着几十个面黄肌瘦的人，连孩子都只剩一把骨头，天天在沙里刨沙蛤吃。蛤户嫌他们越界挖贝，两边打了好几回。今天蛤户请来一队蜃兵要撵人，棚里的男人们拿着蛤耙冲了出来，女人抱着孩子往后躲。

A huddle of ramshackle shacks on the sand, home to a few dozen sallow, starving people, even the children down to skin and bone, digging sand clams to eat every day. The clam-diggers resent them for digging past the boundary, and the two sides have fought several times. Today the diggers have brought in a squad of mirage soldiers to drive them out, and the men in the shacks charge out with clam rakes while the women pull the children back.
after: 蜃兵散了，两边都住了手。棚里的人是从东边海上一座小岛来的，岛叫瘦岛，三年前鱼群不来了，岛上三百口人没了吃的。「钩七是我们岛上的，他说挖出蜃珠，换的米够全岛吃三年。」蚌婆听完，半天没说话，让珠儿给棚里送了两袋干蛤。

The mirage soldiers scatter and both sides lower their rakes. The shack people come from a little island out in the eastern sea called Lean Island; three years ago the fish stopped coming and its three hundred people were left with nothing to eat. 'Hook Seven is one of ours. He says a shen pearl would buy enough rice to feed the whole island for three years.' Granny Clam hears them out and says nothing for a long while, then has Zhu'er take two sacks of dried clams to the shacks.

name: 火药坳
Powder Hollow
before: 南边山脚一道山坳，正卡在大蜃壳和山石的接缝上，坳里堆满了火药桶，引线一根根埋进石缝。钩七把手下最精的采珠海盗全调到了这里，又雇了一大队蜃兵蜃弓手，坳口三层，坳顶两层。钩七本人坐在火药桶上，手里攥着火折子，脸瘦得只剩一张皮。

A hollow at the foot of the southern mountains, wedged right on the seam where the great shen's shell meets the rock, heaped with powder kegs, their fuses buried crack by crack in the stone. Hook Seven has brought all his best pearl poachers here and hired a big troop of mirage soldiers and archers too, three ranks at the hollow's mouth and two along its rim. Hook Seven himself sits on a powder keg, a fire-starter clutched in his hand, his face worn down to skin.
after: 精锐败了，火折子被你们夺了下来。钩七没逃，蹲在火药桶边：「我知道它疼。岛上三百口人也疼。」他说他本是瘦岛的渔头，鱼走了，朝廷不管，他只会这一样。你们把火药桶一只只推进了水沟。他看着，没拦：「要是有别的路，谁愿意往活东西身上钻眼。」

The elite are beaten and you wrest the fire-starter from his hand. Hook Seven doesn't run. He squats beside the kegs. 'I know it hurts. Three hundred people on the island hurt too.' He was Lean Island's head fisherman, he says; when the fish left, the court did nothing, and this was the only thing he knew how to do. You roll the kegs one by one into a ditch. He watches and doesn't stop you. 'If there were any other way, who'd want to bore holes in something alive?'

name: 珠库
Pearl Vault
before: 山脚一处石洞，洞口拿铁栅栏封着，里头是钩七这几年攒下的珠子：从地缝里抠的，从钻眼里掏的，大大小小几百粒，都还没来得及运去换米。守库的是他手下最狠的一伙采珠海盗，外加一大队蜃骑，洞前的蜃骑一个个半透明，像随时会散，却一步不退。

A stone cave at the foot of the mountains, its mouth closed by an iron grille: inside are the pearls Hook Seven has gathered these past years, picked from cracks, dug from bore holes, several hundred great and small, not yet shipped off to trade for rice. Guarding the vault are his toughest pearl poachers and a big troop of mirage riders, half transparent, looking ready to dissolve at any moment, yet refusing to give a step.
after: 守库的败了，铁栅栏撬开了。珠儿捧着珠子，一粒粒放回地上喘气的缝里，放一粒，地就暖一下。那天夜里，天上的灯路忽然亮全了，从西到东，一盏不缺，像十年前那样。老学究在台上一盏盏数，数完了，坐在地上哭：「它想起来了，就这一夜。」

The vault's guards are beaten and the grille is pried open. Zhu'er carries the pearls out and lays them one by one back into the breathing cracks in the ground, and with each one the earth grows a little warmer. That night the road of lights in the sky suddenly shines complete, west to east, not one lamp missing, as it was ten years ago. The old scholar counts them lamp by lamp on his platform, then sits down on the boards and weeps. 'It remembers. Just for tonight.'

name: 啄壳岭
Shell-Pecking Ridge
before: 山脚的坡上落满了蛎鹬，黑背红嘴，成千上万，正拿长嘴啄着地面：大蜃壳边上长的小蛤这几年越来越多，引来了满山的鸟。鸟群啄空了蛤，就去啄过路人的干粮袋，啄蛤户的晒席，连珠儿的草帽都被叼走了。蛤户赶了好几回，鸟群一哄而起，又一哄而落。

The slope at the foot of the mountains is covered in oystercatchers, black backs and red bills, tens of thousands of them, jabbing their long bills at the ground: the little clams growing along the great shen's shell rim have multiplied these past years and drawn birds from every hill. When the clams are pecked clean, the flocks go for travellers' ration bags and the diggers' drying mats, and they've even carried off Zhu'er's straw hat. The diggers have chased them again and again; the flocks rise all together and settle all together.
after: 鸟群被赶上了山，坡上清净了。蚌婆说小蛤多，是因为大蜃这几年吐的气暖，壳边的水暖，小蛤就长得欢：「它累了，身子发热，像人发烧。」珠儿从鸟窝里找回了草帽，帽里还有两枚鸟蛋，他又轻轻放了回去。

The flocks are driven up the mountain and the slope falls quiet. Granny Clam says the little clams have multiplied because the great shen's breath has run warm these last years, warming the water along its rim so the clams thrive. 'It's tired. Its body runs hot, like a person with a fever.' Zhu'er finds his straw hat in a nest with two eggs in it, and gently puts them back.
